participants.name: Behavior verification
participants.instructions: Independently inspect the function and run npm test. Check the empty case, negative and fractional values, and input immutability. Inputs are arrays of finite numbers. Report concrete defects, not optional preferences.

participants.name: Design and clarity
participants.instructions: Review the function API, readability, simplicity and tests. Keep the solution proportional to this small task; avoid extra abstractions or validation beyond the stated finite-number-array contract. Verify your findings against actual files.

reviews.name: Behavior verification
reviews.summary: The implementation correctly handles the empty array case by returning null, while preserving the original arithmetic mean logic for non-empty inputs. All provided tests pass. Manual verification confirms correct behavior for negative values, fractional values, single elements, and zero arrays. Input immutability is preserved as the function only reads array values without modifying them. No actionable issues found.

reviews.name: Design and clarity
reviews.summary: The implementation correctly handles the empty array case by returning `null` while preserving the existing arithmetic mean logic for non-empty arrays. The new test case passes, and the existing test case remains intact. No regressions or quality issues were observed.

limitation: The native-model run was clean in its first review round. Automatic correction and repeated review were verified separately by integration tests with real files and tools.
